study.question: Under exactly the same supplied history, does retaining WHICH action/coarse-age context contains category-brand repetition add predictive information beyond group-level joint entropy/collision, empirical independence, and an unlabeled distribution of conditional repetition?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0013-coupled_context compresses X=(category,brand bucket pair), Y=(action,age bin) within each match group into scalar H(X,Y) and collision mass. These are invariant to equal-mass Y-label exchanges that can change action-specific repetition; learned parent means, independent moments, identity statistics and context margins also collide in the six-event construction below. Its validation AUC 0.6206913502 exceeds independent_context 0.6204980572, marginal_context 0.6205736205 and zero_context 0.6204219223 in one seed; these small effects and a Logloss shift (0.1940340 vs 0.19565..0.19579) require replication and may reflect calibration/optimization. Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics report 107.867 complete events in the neither-match group and multiple contexts for 97.07% of those impressions, suggesting enough support to test conditional repetition but not proving predictive relevance. Retaining 16 labeled conditional X entropies/collision masses per group may expose repeat concentration in a specific behavior/time context that global contingency summaries discard. Repetition is category-brand bucket recurrence, never item recurrence; no temporal sequence-transition claim.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent uses global-per-match H(X,Y) and collision; new branch preserves conditional H(X|Y=y) and collision by labeled context. Explicit collision witness holds all parent feature blocks constant.

nearest_work.difference: DIN adapts weighted behavioral pooling to a candidate. This is a count-based conditional distribution readout over coarse category/brand identities with fixed match groups, no attention or DIN regularization reproduction. Conditional entropy and collision are standard statistics; novelty beyond reviewed local mechanisms remains unverified.
Only the author field warning is verified: category, brand and behavior are available, item histories are absent. No full DMR paper or architecture reproduction; publisher text unavailable.

External systems describe feature transport, history/domain stacks, target-aware tokens/queries and layered dot-product highways. This study changes a sufficient-statistic readout, without those architectures or source supervision. Organizer summaries do not verify detailed original ablations or local transfer.

inherited_components: Complete g1-r0013-coupled_context static MLP and dormant attention allocation
True-match group masked means and log-count summaries
Observed action-age count histograms and independent learned content/context moments
Compact global norm-collapsed field contrasts and once-per-forward history embeddings
Joint category-brand identity entropy/collision residual and joint identity-context entropy/collision residual
Same complete-pair support and packed int64 safety bound; no missing-to-missing identity match

Review of prior trajectories: behavior/field decompositions in rounds 0-1 did not improve DIN; raw counts and true-match grouping helped in rounds 2 and 5; learned content-context moments gave mixed/null evidence in round 7; explicit event-energy branch g1-r0011-event_energy 0.61970493 underperformed pooled_parent 0.62009379; discrete joint identity in round 12 and discrete identity-context in round 13 are promising single-seed trajectories. No failed execution in supplied recent history; unsuccessful scientific contrasts are retained, not called execution failures.
study.proposed_difference: Append one bias-free residual after all existing parameters: 192->16 ReLU->1, final weight initialized to zero (3,088 parameters). For each of four match groups and 16 action-age contexts, on common complete-pair support compute n_y, H(X|Y=y), and sum_x p(x|y)^2. Inputs are log1p(n_y)/ln(129), entropy/ln(129), collision; empty cells are all zero. One additional BxL sorted run aggregation of packed (X,Y,group) keys supplies conditional mass/logmass/squared mass in O(B L log L + B*64) time and O(B L + B*64) memory, no training BxLxL tensor or vocabulary table. Independence control uses H(X),C(X) in occupied contexts (exact empirical p(X)p(Y)); unlabeled control canonically lexicographically sorts full (n_y,H_y,C_y) tuples within each group, preserving their multiset and removing explicit context coordinates; zero control feeds zeros. All four representations are computed in every cell, including three stable length-16 sorts. No primary claim that this standard conditional statistic is globally novel.
predictions: Constructive mechanism check, before scores: with target=(3,3), complete identities [(1,1)]*4+[(2,2)]*2, all ages zero, actions [1,1,1,2,2,2] versus [2,2,2,1,1,1], parent means, all count histograms, identity statistics and global contingency summaries coincide; localized conditional entropy/collision swap. Pure vs mixed contexts have entropy gap H(1/3,2/3)/ln129 and collision gap 4/9. Independent and unlabeled features must coincide for this witness.

Host diagnostic sorted aggregation must agree with independent dense per-event counts within float32 tolerance 2e-5; chain rule reconstructs H(X,Y) from H(Y)+sum_y p_y H(X|y); joint collision reconstructs from sum_y p_y^2 C(X|y). Empty/masked/missing-only/zero-length inputs remain finite and added residual exactly zero.

If context assignment matters, localized_repeat should exceed both independent_repeat and unlabeled_repeat in full-validation AUC at the same recipe, with repeated paired seed direction needed for supported predictive attribution. It must also beat zero_repeat to justify incremental complexity. Any first-seed gain is exploratory, with no significance claim.

If unlabeled_repeat matches localized_repeat while both beat independent_repeat, conditional heterogeneity may matter without identifying action/age placement. If independent_repeat matches the candidate, extra readout/representation rather than retained empirical coupling is sufficient.

Report full-validation Logloss alongside AUC, host parameters, train/wall/GPU time when supplied, examples, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 whole-batch latency. The new sort can make every new cell slower than the parent; no equal-compute efficiency conclusion from matched passes alone. Slice bins stay frozen; include sample/positive/negative counts and mark sparse subgroups. Diagnostic first-512 prevalence is not a population estimate.
falsifiers: Witness parent/independent/unlabeled features differ materially, or conditional feature gap vanishes; then claimed information distinction is invalid.

Scalar/dense formulas disagree, support differs across modes, non-finite output occurs, packed keys overflow, masked or missing-only entries contribute, or host cost exceeds the unchanged per-trial cap; treat as implementation/integrity failure rather than scientific refutation.

Candidate does not beat zero and independence/unlabeled controls across paired repetitions: no supported predictive benefit for labeled conditional recurrence under this recipe, without refuting all possible conditional-history models.
Only Logloss improves, or AUC effects reverse over seeds/slices: narrow claim to observed calibration or unstable optimization; do not declare established coupling mechanism or cost advantage.
alternative_explanations: Extra head provides easier approximation of statistics already implicitly available, or changes optimization/calibration; independence and zero controls are necessary.

Unlabeled diversity heterogeneity may suffice. Canonical sorting removes explicit context coordinates but existing parent margins can partially recover associations when context masses are unique; equal-mass witness isolates exact non-recoverability. This is a structured replacement, not a randomized conditional-independence test.
Same allocated parameters do not imply equal effective capacity; zero branch has no active signal and conditional products/sorted representations have different geometry.
A seed-42 gain after many adaptively selected validation experiments can be selection noise; paired seeds are not independent mechanism contrasts or an untouched holdout.

Empirical diversity is biased at small cell sizes; no unbiased population mutual-information claim. Most history prefixes are truncated at 128 and coarse identities may collide due to hashing; no inference beyond supplied support.

Static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; this remains a frozen benchmark assumption, not verified production point-in-time data. No raw re-audit or production causality claim is possible in this jail.
